verdict.rationale: The docs state that API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses, which implies UI/API parity by design. Supporting evidence includes an OpenAI-compatible gateway that exposes workspaces as models and webhooks that can post messages into channels. The parity claim itself rests on a single first-party sentence, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec on the docs site. Missing for 10: a published API reference/OpenAPI spec covering UI features (memory, channels, automations, RBAC, files), independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
